title: RoShift: Lazy Shift and Weight-aware Rotation for Activation Sparsity in LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.20549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation sparsity accelerates LLM decoding by skipping unnecessary weight reads and computation. However, SiLU-based LLMs exhibit little natural sparsity, and imposing high sparsity can substantially degrade accuracy. We propose RoShift, a training-free method that transforms activations into sparsity-friendly representations. RoShift introduces lazy shift, which recenters SiLU activation distributions around zero and defers correction to the end of the FFN to obtain additional sparsity. It also reduces sparsification-induced output error through rotation that jointly accounts for activation and weight information. By fusing the corrections required for shifting and rotation, RoShift translates these gains into decoding speedup. At 50% and 60% sparsity, RoShift improves average accuracy over TEAL by 1.60 and 3.29 percentage points, respectively, across five models. translated_title: RoShift：面向大语言模型推理中激活稀疏性的惰性平移与权重感知旋转
translated_abstract: 激活稀疏性通过跳过不必要的权重读取和计算来加速大语言模型（LLM）的解码。然而，基于SiLU的LLM几乎不具备自然稀疏性，且强行施加高稀疏性会显著降低准确率。我们提出RoShift，这是一种无需训练的方法，可将激活值转换为利于稀疏化的表示。RoShift引入了惰性平移，将SiLU激活分布重新居中于零附近，并将校正推迟到FFN末端以获得额外的稀疏性。它还通过联合考虑激活与权重信息的旋转来减少稀疏化引起的输出误差。通过融合平移和旋转所需的校正，RoShift将这些增益转化为解码加速。在50%和60%稀疏度下，RoShift在五个模型上的平均准确率分别比TEAL提高了1.60和3.29个百分点，并在稠密模型上实现了最高1.72倍的解码加速。
tldr: RoShift是一种无需训练的方法，通过惰性平移和权重感知旋转将激活变换为利于稀疏化的表示，在显著提升稀疏化后准确率的同时，最高可实现1.72倍的LLM解码加速。
en_tdlr: RoShift is a training-free method that transforms activations into sparsity-friendly representations via lazy shift and weight-aware rotation, significantly improving accuracy under sparsification while achieving up to 1.72× LLM decoding speedup.
